children: CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday that his company is preparing for a broader market rollout of its driver assistance software, Full Self-Driving (FSD) version 15, next month as part of the EV maker’s holiday update.

“FSD V15 goes to wide release next month. It will be something special,” Musk wrote on X. When a user asked if V15 will be part of the company’s holiday update, the billionaire investor replied, “Yes.”
His announcement came shortly after Tesla’s
Super Intelligence account on X teased the launch on Friday by posting “XV,” the Roman numeral for 15.
While Musk’s post lacked other specifics of the launch, including which geographies will initially receive FSD V15, the tech entrepreneur offered a few clues on several features Tesla

When one owner asked if V15 will finally have the ability to avoid potholes and park in a home garage, Musk said, "Yeah," adding, “The new user interface will re-render reality in a mind-bending way. Hard to describe, but it’s awesome.”

title: Tesla to launch FSD 15 next month, Elon Musk says
